# Anne Shirley & Matthew Cuthbert

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) — best of friends · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026), [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P30](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), +2 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) brings [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home, where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) expresses shock upon discovering she is a girl rather than the expected boy. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) breaks down in tears when she realizes she is not wanted, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) allows her to stay overnight in the east gable room. After putting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to bed, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) insists on sending her back, while [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) gently suggests they might keep her.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wakes up at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and admiringly takes in the surrounding nature, though she remembers she cannot stay. She eats breakfast with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), then offers to do household chores while sharing her imaginative thoughts. After dinner, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) prepares to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) to return her, while [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) silently indicates his desire to keep her.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to bed and instructs her on neatness and saying bedtime prayers. After finding out [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has never prayed, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) has her improvise a prayer, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) recites in an unorthodox manner. Afterwards, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) goes down to the kitchen and complains to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) about Anne's lack of religious upbringing, resolving to educate her.
>

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) secretly visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her room and persuades her to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) so she can leave her punishment. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dramatically apologizes to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who forgives her completely and gives her flowers. As [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walk back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) feels a warm surge of affection for the girl despite her theatrical nature.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scolds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for decorating her hat with wild flowers at church, but then offers to introduce her to [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). They visit [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) quickly form a deep friendship and pledge to be bosom friends forever. Returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), a delighted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares her excitement with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) brings [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a gift of sweeties.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discovers her missing brooch caught in a black lace shawl and realizes Anne's false confession was fabricated just to be allowed to go to the picnic. Apologetic for doubting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) sends her off to the event with Jerry driving, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later returns home delighted after a wonderful day.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) admits her mistake regarding the brooch and forgives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), allowing her to get ready for the Sunday school picnic after all. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home overjoyed after having a wonderful time at the picnic, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) later reflects on the incident with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).
>

> After Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) publicly punishes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for being late by forcing her to sit next to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), she refuses to ever return to his school. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) consults [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who advises letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) cool off at home for a while. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is overcome with laughter when she finds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) weeping over an imagined future scenario where [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) gets married and leaves her.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers that Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) believes she intentionally got [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drunk on currant wine and refuses to let them play together anymore. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realizes she put the wine where the cordial should have been and tries to reason with Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md), but Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) remains unforgiving. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) personally pleads with Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) to no avail, leaving her heartbroken, while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) shows a rare moment of tenderness toward the sleeping girl.
>

> While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is away in town, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) seeks help at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) when her little sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) falls ill with severe croup. Drawing on her past experience caring for twins, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) successfully treats [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) through the night before the doctor arrives. The next day, Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) forgives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and invites her to resume her friendship with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).
>

> After [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attend the concert and stay overnight at Diana's house, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) enjoy the performance and return to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) late at night. They run and leap onto the spare-room bed, inadvertently jumping on Diana's sleeping Great-[Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). The next day, after learning that [Miss Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) is furious and threatening to cut off Diana's music lessons, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) expresses her remorse to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).
>

> After discussing the situation with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to confess to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) for jumping onto her bed. Anne's honest explanation and charm amuse [Miss Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), persuading her to forgive [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). The two become close friends, and [Miss Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) eventually invites [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to visit her in the city.
>

> At a party, [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md) dares [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk the ridgepole of the [Barry](../character/barry.md) kitchen roof. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attempts it, falls off, and breaks her ankle. During her long recovery at home, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realizes how deeply she cares for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), who is visited by many supportive friends and neighbors while longing to return to school.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and thrives under the guidance of her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). At home, she enthusiastically shares her school experiences and upcoming concert roles with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) remains skeptical of the concert's value, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) offers [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) his warm encouragement.
>

> Noticing that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) lacks fashionable clothing like other girls, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) tries to buy her a dress at Lawson's store but becomes flustered by the clerk, Miss [Harris](../character/harris.md). He seeks help from Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who agrees to buy and sew a stylish brown dress with puffed sleeves for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). On [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) morning, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is overjoyed to receive the dress from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), along with a pair of slippers sent by [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md).
>

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) presents [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) gift of elegant slippers from [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). [The Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) concert takes place that evening, where Anne's recitations are a huge success. Afterward, as they walk home, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) mentions [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) saving Anne's dropped rose, while back at home, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) proudly discuss Anne's performance and her future education.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) expecting supper, but finds the stove unlit and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) nowhere in sight. When [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) goes upstairs, she discovers [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) hiding under her pillows because she dyed her red hair green using hair dye bought from a peddler. After washing fails to remove the green color, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) cuts Anne's hair off short, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reflect remorsefully on her vanity.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) bid farewell to [Miss Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), who reflects warmly on Anne's pleasant presence. The girls enjoy their scenic evening drive back to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) welcome her home with a hot supper.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys an active summer outdoors following the doctor's advice and returns to her studies in autumn with renewed vigor. As the school year progresses, she prepares intensely for the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams under Miss Stacy's guidance. Meanwhile, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) notices with mixed feelings how tall and mature [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has become as she turns fifteen.
>

> After finishing school and taking her [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) anxiously awaits the results at home. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes over to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the newspaper to announce that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tied for first place on the entire [Island](../codex/places.md#island), bringing great joy and pride to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dress in her east gable room before driving to the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) for a benefit concert with [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) and [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md). Despite an initial wave of severe stage fright upon seeing the sophisticated crowd and high-caliber performers, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) sees [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the audience and finds the resolve to deliver a triumphant recitation, earning an encore and praise from the guests.
>

> After giving an encored performance at the concert, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys praised introductions, supper with her friends, and compliments about her reciting. On the drive home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) reflect on wealth, luxury, and contentment, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) asserting that she is happy to remain herself.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares to leave for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) and shares a heartwarming moment with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) as she tries on a new dress. After arriving in town, she starts her classes and experiences severe homesickness at her boarding house. However, visits from her [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) classmates and news about the prestigious Avery scholarship renew her spirit and ambition.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) collapses and dies suddenly after reading news of the bank failure. The household and community mourn, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comfort each other in their shared sorrow. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her grief with Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and reminisces with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about past times and Marilla's youthful romance with John Blythe.
>
